title: Zilker closes by the week
subtitle: Parking and road closures for the Austin City Limits Music Festival load-in
alt: Timeline of Austin City Limits Music Festival load-in closures around Zilker Park in 2026: the Stratford Lot closed September 14; the Pecan Grove and Polo Picnic lots close September 18; the festival grounds and Great Lawn close to the public at midnight September 21; the Rock Garden Lot closes September 23; Barton Springs Road closes fully from 3 a.m. to 7 a.m. on September 26, with lane reductions the rest of that day; the Disc Golf, Moonlight Tower and Playscape lots close September 28; and full daytime closures of Barton Springs Road run September 28 through 30 and again on October 1 until 7 p.m. All of the closures lift October 18
source: City of Austin ACL Mobility Guide, via KXAN
